title: Fleet status returns saved observations under host load
description: Run on the gateway host against an explicitly selected authenticated gateway. Retains real response timings, host load and original observation times. Never changes a slot, starts a worker or retries a timed-out request.

proofTargets.claim: Three authenticated fleet.status reads return actual saved rows within two seconds on the gateway host.

read.intent: Read saved fleet rows three times using the normal client deadline.

observed.intent: Require real rows, measured fast replies and closed client transport.
